calibration.openers: temperature scaling on the 3-class logits (argmax-preserving), NLL on a declared grid

gene_map.open_margin: quantile(EV over the allowed cells POOLED over both sides, calibration flat rows, 1 - open_rate): one absolute margin for both sides
gene_map.nop_veto: absolute threshold on calibrated P(NOP) (gene nop_veto in [0.30, 0.95])
gene_map.positioned_visits: the round-0 INNER_A exploration visits (TP / SL drawn from the grid; NO expert position): strategy-free
gene_map.frozen: on the calibration block before the search; recorded in the strategy doc (gene_map)
gene_map.feasibility_probe: corners of the continuous genes + the q-max point + the side-balance corner (both open rates at their maximum); no point VALID under the activity CI and side rules with >= 1 agent close -> STRATEGY_SPACE_INFEASIBLE
gene_map.close_margin_l: -quantile(predicted remaining value, calibration LONG positioned visits, close_rem_rate_l)
gene_map.close_margin_s: -quantile(predicted remaining value, calibration SHORT positioned visits, close_rem_rate_s)
gene_map.close_p_l: absolute threshold on calibrated P(SL first) (gene close_p_l in [0.30, 0.95])
gene_map.close_p_s: absolute threshold on calibrated P(SL first) (gene close_p_s in [0.30, 0.95])

strategy.rule: flat: per side, the ALLOWED cell (TP >= SL, or predicted net > cost + rr_margin) with the highest predicted net; EV = P(TP first) * TP - P(SL first) * SL + P(TIME) * E[net | TIME] - cost (probabilities of the 3-class head at the reference cell, temperature-calibrated); open the side with the higher EV among those with EV > open_margin (one pooled margin; exact tie -> no trade) and (veto kept) pNOP <= nop_veto; 'no trade' is valid; positioned: CLOSE when the closer's predicted remaining < -close_margin_side OR calibrated P(SL first) > close_p_side (per-side thresholds), then reverse when allow_reverse and the open rule names the other side

optimizer.constraint: Deb constraint domination: feasible = the CI90 lower bound of trades/week >= 2.0 (weekly-block bootstrap) AND no side above 90 % of entries AND the env rules; violation = (2.0 - lower bound)+ + (side share - 0.90)+ + env

strategy.choice: the arm's fitness variant picks the frozen point among the valid non-dominated (Sharpe, DD) points; ties -> lower max DD
strategy.early_close_rule: owner 2026-10-25 (pre-registered before any audit number was read): early close is indispensable; with strategy.require_early_close a point that never closes voluntarily on the calibration block (agent closes = 0) is DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable; it stays in the archive
strategy.costs: inside the targets: every predicted net is the engine's net result (spread, slippage, commission, financing)
strategy.activity_rule: on the calibration block the activity rule is met when the LOWER bound of the 90 % confidence interval of trades/week is >= 2.0: weekly-block bootstrap (resample the decision weeks with replacement, 2000 draws, seed 20261025) of the entries per decision week, the engine's week definition (ISO weeks with decisions); out of sample the rule stays exactly >= 2.0 trades/week (period average) - owner 2026-10-25: 'Con confianza estadística'

activity_ci.unit: entries per decision week (ISO weeks with decisions)

strategy.side_rule: side balance: a strategy point whose entries on the calibration block put more than 90 % on one side violates the constraint (violation = share - 0.90), handled by Deb constraint domination together with the activity violation (sum); such points are archived and never selectable
strategy.fitness_diversity: reported per (arm, fold): selectable front size and distinct points chosen across the variants; fewer than 5 selectable front points = FRONT_TOO_SMALL, and the final search is rerun once with the escalated budget (declared)
strategy.side_symmetry: open: EV_L and EV_S are computed by the same function with mirrored inputs and compared against ONE absolute margin; the higher EV wins; ties -> no privileged side (HOLD); the NOP veto, the gate and the activity rule see no side; witness = the swap test (mirrored head outputs must mirror the actions) and the per-tick decision ledger (EV_L, EV_S, margin, winner, reason)
strategy.name: c3_ev_per_side

ev_rule.e_time: mean engine net of TIME outcomes per side at the reference cell on TRAIN (declared constant)
ev_rule.cost: median over the calibration rows of the per-row cost (declared allowance + round trip / sigma)

rr_floor.rule: TP >= SL always allowed; TP < SL only when predicted net > cost + rr_margin

ev_rule.activity: a VALIDITY criterion (>= 2.0 trades/week lower CI bound on calibration); never a reason to open at negative EV

early_close_benefit.statistic: mean daily P&L difference (with early close - never close), USD
early_close_benefit.rule: early close is kept only when exec_variants.early_close_ok passes: agent closes >= 5 % of the exits on the block AND the lower 90 % bound of the mean daily difference >= 0; otherwise the unit runs with early close DISABLED and is flagged early_close_disabled (reported, never hidden)

params.rule: every strategy coefficient lives in this file (validated against strategy_params.BOUNDS); the frozen contract embeds the sha of the point it was proven with

visitation.round0: exploration positions only (visited STATES, TP / SL from the grid), never the expert
visitation.rounds: 1..3: the C3 policy at the visitation strategy frozen on INNER_A (closer rows appended, closers refitted)
visitation.openers_and_nop: fitted once in round 0 (their rows are every clean-account eligible flat row)

inputs.hours_held: (open time of bar b + 1 h - open time of the fill bar) / 1 h / 24

closer_order_geometry.sigma_entry: the decision sigma the engine used to set this order's levels (Position.sigma)
closer_order_geometry.causality: computed after bar b from the open order's own levels and close[b]; nothing after b enters
closer_order_geometry.network_input: closers: recipe window (+) the nine agent-state slots as constant zeros (as C2) (+) these four values; openers / NOP: as C2
closer_order_geometry.forbidden: any other state slot for any specialist (balance, equity, PnL history, entries count, agent outputs, can_enter, ...); geometry on openers or NOP

label_rules.openers: every clean-account eligible flat row of the period (gate open: A2-10); the daily cap is enforced by the env only, never in a label (A2-5)
label_rules.closers: exploration visits only in round 0 (A2-6), the student's own visits in DAgger rounds relabelled with the SAME engine rule (A2-5); duplicates by (row, side, geometry) deduplicated, ties dropped (A2-4)
label_rules.zigzag: no ZigZag target (A2-11 not applicable); NOP keeps the multires ladder labels

open_l.decision.consumed_by: EV = P(TP)*TP_cell - P(SL)*SL_cell + P(TIME)*E[net|TIME] - cost (probabilities at the reference cell); OPEN_LONG iff EV_L > open_margin (ONE pooled quantile gene) and EV_L > EV_S when both clear, and the gate places it

open_s.decision.consumed_by: as open_l for OPEN_SHORT (same margin; the higher EV wins; exact tie -> HOLD)

open_l.continuous.range: each in [-4, 4] sigma (predicted engine net per unit / sigma)
open_l.continuous.consumed_by: cell choice only: argmax over the ALLOWED cells (TP >= SL, or net > cost + rr_margin; inside the per-bar band); never thresholded into an action by itself

nop.decision.consumed_by: veto: no open when P(NOP) > nop_veto (quantile gene); kept only if it improves the selection-block lower bound

close_l.decision.consumed_by: CLOSE when P(SL first) > close_p_l (per-side quantile gene on long positioned visits)

head_outputs.closer_inputs: recipe window + the order's own geometry (dist to SL / TP in sigma_entry, hours held / 24, side); openers / NOP: recipe window only
head_outputs.gate: the EV of the chosen open is the SCORE of exec_variants.BestOfDayGate (observe 1 signal per business day, then the first EV >= the day's running best)
head_outputs.early_close_switch: exec_variants.early_close_ok(agent close share >= 0.05, value lower bound >= 0) on the selection block; on failure the closers are not consulted (flagged)

encoding_decisions.regime_gmm_rule: rg.gmm.p0/p1/p2 -> one-hot of the row's argmax regime (3 binary columns, entropy kept)
encoding_decisions.event_clock_rule: ev.<x>.hours_since -> 1 within 2 h after the event or 2 h before the next (period 24 h); ev.<x>.hours_to dropped (= 24 - hours_since, A1-4 duplicate)

exec_variant.name: full_f3
exec_variant.fixes: A4-1 reversal = one entry decision; A4-4 risk 1 % sizing; A4-9 entry cutoff 24 h before the forced flat; A4-12 ask-side short triggers

cutoff_eligibility.consequence: under the 1 entry/day cap the 24 h cutoff leaves ~4 slots/week, so the activity rule (CI90 lower bound >= 2.0) needs entries on most eligible days; both cutoffs stay declared variants and Phase 0's simulation decides which one the frozen parameters use (--exec-variant full_f3 | full_f3_12h | legacy)

best_of_day.rule: A4-2: causal secretary rule per business day (exec_variants.BestOfDayGate): the first eligible open signal of the day is observed only; then the first open whose EV >= the day's running best is placed (observe 3 was infeasible under full_f3's 24 h cutoff: the 1 entry/day cap leaves ~4 slots/week and the secretary rule loses the day whenever the best signal fell inside the window; smoke 2026-10-26: best 1.26/wk)

architecture.note: inside the sealed identity (2026-10-26): residual_tcn (DEFAULT, owner order: every model of this line) = per-group single causal conv, SiLU, 1x1 fusion 8, two residual causal blocks (dilations 1, 2), flatten readout (temporal.py, parity-tested against Musashi's GroupedTCNExtractor); u = the sealed u-design conv1d trunk, a declared CONTROL arm only

closer_head.name: first-passage curve head (market-only best continuation), tools/strategy_output_simulation.BCHead
closer_head.inputs: market data only: the bars from the decision bar on, the per-bar spread profile, the session calendar (compulsory flats, rollovers) and the swap rates by side; NO position, entry, SL, TP, units or balance
closer_head.indexing: per decision bar b and side s; lead h = 1 .. H over the future bars b + h
closer_head.horizon_H: variable: the bars up to the first compulsory flat after b + 1 (<= one trading week of hourly bars)
closer_head.units: sigma of now = the causal decision sigma at b; values relative to closing now at the open of b + 1

channels.adv: running adverse excursion reached by bar b + h (the stop side, shorts at ask)
channels.fav: running favourable excursion reached by bar b + h (the take-profit side, through limit_through)
channels.pm: best net value of a discretionary close decided at or before b + h (fill at the next open, exit cost and financing included)
channels.o: open of b + h relative to the open of b + 1
channels.gap: the gap test price of b + h (shorts at ask)
channels.cs: stop exit cost relative to a market close now
channels.ct: take-profit exit cost relative to a market close now
channels.fo: financing accrued to an open fill at b + h
channels.fc: financing accrued to an intrabar / close fill at b + h
channels.ff: net value of the compulsory flat at the close of the last bar (scalar)

closer_head.decoder: the strategy (L2) supplies only its position's remaining distances d_sl = s (liq_now - SL) / sigma and d_tp = s (TP - liq_now) / sigma; first stop bar = first h with adv >= d_sl, first take-profit bar = first h with fav >= d_tp (a shared bar goes to the stop unless the take-profit gaps at the open); BC = max(pm before the terminating bar, the termination's net value); A(t) = -BC in sigma of the trade
closer_head.quality: rho = sin(pi (level - 1/2)) at the reference lead h_ref = 24 bars; the decoded BC carries an unbiased error of sd = sigma_for_rho(rho, 1 sigma) x sqrt(h / 24), h = the lead (bars) at which the decisive value lies (one draw per decision bar and side)
closer_head.proof_market_only: BCHead.row(b, s) takes no position argument; SimCloser.advantage reads the position only to compute (d_sl, d_tp) and never the trade's own path (tests/test_strategy_behaviour_matrix.py)
